about.title: About this project
about.what: Abruzzese di paese is an open-source dictionary and archive of the Abruzzese dialect. It runs as a static site with search in the browser, and the data is maintained as plain files that anyone can improve through a pull request.
about.source: The entries were imported once from the Treppecore archive on abruzzo.fm, whose editors kindly gave written permission to publish them.
about.radio: abruzzo.fm is Radio Abruzzo, the only radio station in the world devoted entirely to Abruzzese music and content:
about.contribute: Suggest a word or a correction on GitHub, or edit an entry directly from its page.
about.licences: Dictionary data is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Code is licensed MIT.
